column1: # A *successful* Blink (`In Por`) on the Britannia overworld, to measure the
# `magic.md` Section 8 lists Blink among the utility effects that have "a short
# narration message" and does not give it, and Section 12 says the non-combat
# cast "is direction-prompted and deterministic". Until tonight this engine
# invented `Blinked North to (12, 7) in BRITANNIA.`; that is removed and the
# site prints nothing pending `cleak/u5-spec#262`. This scenario captures what
# the original says so the question can be answered from a measurement rather
# `cast-blink` reaches the same spell indoors and measures the `C/O` scene
# refusal; this one reaches the success arm.
# requires-seed: the party on the Britannia overworld at 02:00 with spell
